title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-15
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains, sorted descending
ranking_explanation: Sorted the visible daily GitHub Trending entries by their displayed stars-today values, descending, and retained the 12 highest of the 15 visible entries. The displayed gains are GitHub's own Trending figures, not independently computed star deltas.
global_caveat: Trending values and repository metadata are live snapshots and can change. GitHub does not document the full Trending ranking algorithm. Total stars and commit SHAs were read from the REST API shortly after the Trending page fetch. Search API activity results are corroborative, not the ranking source.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Daily GitHub Trending snapshot fetched 2026-11-15 01:46 UTC; date range 2026-11-15 through 2026-11-15. Ranking basis: daily GitHub Trending star gains, sorted descending.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Coding-agent infrastructure dominates today's leading momentum: agent-specific web guidance, review, browser debugging, and trading workflows all rank near the top. The broader list also shows strong interest in collaborative office software and self-hosted personal/operations tools.

sections.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
sections.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
sections.why_notable: It leads today's observed star-gain list and packages browser expertise as installable, searchable, token-efficient agent guidance.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
sections.why_notable: A strong daily gain supports the push toward specialized review agents, with the README describing multi-language checks and configurable model endpoints.

sections.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
sections.why_notable: Its momentum highlights demand for agents that can inspect, debug, automate, and profile a live browser rather than only edit source files.

sections.title: we-promise/sure
sections.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
sections.why_notable: It is the strongest non-agent-specific project among the top daily gainers and brings a substantial self-hosted finance app back into active community development.

sections.title: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
sections.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
sections.why_notable: It represents a growing pattern of domain-specific agent skills that structure decisions rather than automate trades or promise signals.

sections.title: dream-num/univer
sections.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
sections.why_notable: Its gain points to interest in embedding spreadsheet and office capabilities into agent-aware products.

sections.title: louislam/uptime-kuma
sections.why_notable: Continued attention to practical, self-hosted infrastructure sits alongside the day's agent-tool surge.

sections.title: Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo
sections.description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.
sections.why_notable: It is a high-momentum outlier in desktop media and graphics rather than coding-agent tooling.
sections.unique_caveat: Game-specific performance and DLSS compatibility claims come from the repository description and were not independently validated.

sections.title: backnotprop/plannotator
sections.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
sections.why_notable: The project makes human approval and plan/diff feedback a visible part of agent-assisted coding.

sections.title: martin-olivier/airgorah
sections.why_notable: It is a security-focused counterpoint to the dominant AI and productivity projects.
sections.unique_caveat: The README says it is Linux-only, requires compatible Wi-Fi hardware, and is intended only for networks the user owns or is authorized to test.

sections.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
sections.description: why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.
sections.why_notable: Its visible daily gain adds evidence for experimentation with lower-token agent interaction, though its existing star base is already exceptionally large.

sections.title: QwenLM/qwen-code
sections.description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
sections.why_notable: It adds an established, model-backed terminal coding agent to the day's broader agent ecosystem signal.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Coding-agent context and workflow tooling: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src, tradermonty/claude-trading-skills, backnotprop/plannotator, and JuliusBrussee/caveman. Agents gaining tools to act on software: alibaba/open-code-review, ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp, and QwenLM/qwen-code. Agent-aware productivity and self-hosting: dream-num/univer, we-promise/sure, and louislam/uptime-kuma. Other niches include Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo (graphics/media) and martin-olivier/airgorah (Wi-Fi security auditing). Languages among the 12 listed: TypeScript 5, Go 2, and Python, Ruby, JavaScript, C++, and Rust 1 each.

themes.name: Agents gaining tools to act on software

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's snapshot is less about a single new model than the software around agents: curated context, domain workflows, code review, browser access, and human feedback. The concurrent gains for office, finance, monitoring, media, and security tools show that the trend is broadening beyond coding assistants into practical products and infrastructure.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, fetched 2026-11-15 01:46 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository and commit endpoints for all 12 listed repositories; GitHub Search API query pushed:2026-11-14..2026-11-15 stars:>1000 sorted by stars matched two listed repos in its returned results. Gains are GitHub's displayed daily Trending figures, sorted descending; no prior-window comparison is made.
